sources.title: Graphon, the Multimodal Memory for AI
sources.snippet: Graphon finds and connects meaningful moments, people, places and things across videos, images and text, and turns them into context, so AI can actually work.

sources.title: Data Driven Grapheme-to-Phoneme Representations for a Lexicon-Free
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a new mechanism to train the Grapheme-to-Phoneme model without the need of any lexicon. We use Text-to-Speech as a use-case to show the effectiveness of our G2P model. We first use unlabeled speech data to pre-train a HuBERT [15] for three iterations.

sources.title: Grapheme-to-Phoneme Models — NVIDIA NeMo Framework User Guide
sources.snippet: A single model that can handle OOVs and heteronyms and replace dictionary lookups can significantly simplify and improve the quality of synthesized speech. We support the following G2P models: ByT5 G2P a text-to-text model that is based on ByT5 [g2p-3] neural network model that was originally proposed in [g2p-5] and [g2p-4].

sources.title: G2P Model: Neural Grapheme-to-Phoneme Mapping
sources.snippet: A Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P) model is a computational system that maps written language sequences (graphemes) to their corresponding phonemic representations.
